metadata.case_name: TSE YIE CHEONG v. WONG MAN PING

plaintiff.occupation_before: Employed by Mr. Lee Wing in a meat business; also worked for Mr. Ma Kang Yuen herding animals in an abattoir (2 hours every day) receiving $70 per day
plaintiff.occupation_after: Returned to work for Mr. Lee Wing on 2.10.85 on a charitable basis (fetch and carry job)

source: He was sustained fractures of both femurs and compound fractures of right tibia and fibula.

injuries.description: compound fractures of right tibia and fibula
source: He was sustained fractures of both femurs and compound fractures of right tibia and fibula.

injuries.description: the osteomyelitis which had developed so severely in the right tibia
source: the osteomyelitis which had developed so severely in the right tibia did not respond to conservative treatment.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: a righty below knee amputation had to be performed on 20.4.84
source: a righty below knee amputation had to be performed on 20.4.84.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right knee and ankle

injuries.description: The fractured right femur was treated conservatively.
source: The fractured right femur was treated conservatively.

manifestations.description: Pain at the stump of the right amputated leg
development of a bursa and the dog ear at the stump
Stump of the leg is two inches below the knee from the margins and three inches from the end of the stump. A fully functional stump should be at least 4 inches.
If the Plaintiff walks for more than 20 minutes, the skin tends to break down and at the examination he had 3 Band Aids on the stump where there were small open abrasions.
limited mobility as a man with only one leg

treatments_received: 14.11.83 Open reduction, surgical toilet, external fixition for the compound fractures of the right tibia and fibula.
22.11.83 Open reduction and internal fixition of the fractured left femur with AO plate, partial thickness skin graft to the right lag.
7.2.84 Exploration and curettage of the infected right tibia.
20.4.84 righty below knee amputation had to be performed on 20.4.84.
9.10.84 Revision of amputation (prominent bone end trimmed, bursa curetted, dog ear excised).
He has been supplied with a prosthesis or artificial leg.
treatments_future: Replacement of artificial leg (prosthesis) at least every two years for expectation of life (14 replacements)

losses.description: much reduced degree of mobility; prosthesis not satisfactory; limited mobility with only one leg
loss of earning capacity and difficulty finding a job as a man with only one leg and limited mobility

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Ting-lam v. Leung Kam Ming
comparable_cases.injury_description: amputation where a prosthesis could not be used satisfactorily, or multiple injuries resulting in the need for regular treatment for the rest of the victim's life
